mail.invitation.body:
Your turn has come. You can open your targum now:

{link}

Sign in with this address and we'll email you a link. The library is free to read and stays free, and there's no card to add.

We're opening in small groups, so if anything is broken or confusing, reply to this and tell us. That is most of what a small group is for.
